title: Project structure and request flow
summary: Understand source folders, component scanning, and the controller → service → repository flow.

sources.title: Engineering Digest: Structure of Spring Boot Application | What's Inside Your Spring Boot App?
Engineering Digest: Creating REST API using Spring Boot in Hindi | A Step-by-Step Tutorial

richText: A Maven project describes its dependencies and build plugins in pom.xml. The Maven wrapper keeps the Maven version consistent across machines.
src/main/java contains application code. src/main/resources contains configuration and other files packaged with the application.
src/test/java contains test code. target contains Maven build output; do not put application source there.
Place the class with @SpringBootApplication in a root package such as com.example.journal. Put controllers, services and repositories under that package.
Package names determine class identity and component scanning. A directory named service does not register a bean by itself; its class needs registration.
Organize a small project by layers. As it grows, grouping related controllers, services and repositories by feature can keep changes close together.

src/main/java/com/example/journal/
  JournalApplication.java
  controller/JournalController.java
  service/JournalService.java
  repository/JournalRepository.java
  model/JournalEntry.java
src/main/resources/application.yml
src/test/java/com/example/journal/
POST /journal first passes through servlet filters, including security when configured. Spring MVC then finds the matching controller method.
The controller reads the request and translates the result into an HTTP response. It calls a service for application rules.
The service applies rules such as ownership and transaction boundaries. It calls a repository when data must be stored or read.
The repository uses the database driver. The saved data passes back through the service and controller; a message converter writes the response.
This separation helps locate failures: a mapping error belongs near the controller, a permission rule near the service, and a connection error near database configuration.
A bean outside the scanned package may cause a missing-dependency startup error. Confirm the package and bean registration before adding unrelated annotations.
